build.command: RUSTC_WRAPPER= cargo build --locked --offline --release --manifest-path crates/o8d/Cargo.toml --features experimental-session-reads --bin o8d

limitations: Synthetic Linux fixture; not installed or GPUI proof.
Native end-to-end remains slower than TypeScript for these fixtures.
Instrumentation is an unapplied diagnostic patch; production sources were restored byte-for-byte.
Existing full hermetic failures remain tracked; this evidence-only follow-through does not claim full-suite green.

sharedAuthReview.expectedOutcome: Capture each route/credential status from a flag-off TS server, assert reference is never native, preserve that status in native mode; refusal bodies remain strict. Public response bodies/headers retain dedicated startup coverage.

measurement.exactReader: settings::ws_info or settings::identity via dispatch; excludes generic session preflight and connection teardown
measurement.preflight: Generic read-only database open and first network-thread lookup in session_read
measurement.admission: o8d request send through receipt of TS204 using the existing pooled backhaul client
measurement.dispatchOverhead: Broad Rust read stage minus exact reader and generic preflight: scheduling, path/context setup, connection teardown and diagnostic overhead
measurement.transportResidual: Client elapsed minus measured admission and broad Rust read stage: classifier/connection/serialization/transfer/client decode and diagnostic overhead
measurement.statistics: Percentiles are independent and must not be summed; stacked means sum exactly. 10 warmups and100 measured requests per route/transport. No debug timing.

productionSharedModule.covers: Merged chat-list and startup table entries; includes linkedWork and all per-route TS auth outcomes

latestRebase.note: Settings and mobile contexts, auth paths and window-owner fallback retained. Functional replay only; optimized latency above remains the historical release receipt.

fixtureBootRegression.red: reference WS health timed out before any child output at the 30-second fixture deadline
fixtureBootRegression.green: Match the existing shared-session fixture 60-second WS bootstrap budget. The production daemon readiness timeout stays five seconds.

packagingRebase.notes: Retains bundled binary discovery and the startup resolver/version snapshot. Prior full table/auth module replay is recorded under latestRebase; no new latency claim.

mainCallers.populatedCase: Saved WS token and nonzero live ports; real Client::websocket consumes wsPort and wsToken.
Saved identity and nonempty server version; settings_request decodes Identity.
Updater reads persisted identity on the main GET.

queueRebase.preserved: Merged settings, mobile inbox and workspace context/auth paths and packaged binary discovery. Functional checks only; release latency above remains its dated optimized receipt.
